title.narrative: Enhance Voice for the Inclusion of the Vulnerable and their Empowerment (EVOLVE)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is contributing to enable CSOs to bring the voice of women and other disadvantaged groups to local decision-makers and influence policy practices by engaging in policy dialogue for inclusion in governance and development.The specific objective is designed to develop capacities of the CSOs and their networks to empower climate affected communities and disadvantaged groups - especially women - to raise their voices and effectively participate in decision-making processes and hold government accountable, contributing to gender responsive and climate smart policies, financing and their implementation.
